description: The IEEE conference class used by ICRA, IROS and the other IEEE RAS conferences that take papers through PaperPlaza: ieeeconf.cls ('2016/4/23 revision V1.6b by Pradeep Misra', a renamed IEEEtran V1.6b of 2002/11/18), from ieeeconf.zip on ras.papercept.net/conferences/support/tex.php (PaperPlaza's LaTeX support page), with root.tex, the template. Not on CTAN: the mirror's IEEEconf package is a different class (Scott Pakin's IEEEconf.cls v1.4, IEEE Computer Society proceedings) whose file name differs only in case, so the shipped lower-case ieeeconf.cls is the one the engine finds on its case-sensitive file system. Options as root.tex's: letterpaper, 10pt, conference; two columns and oneside are the class defaults (l.797). The first two preamble lines are root.tex's own: in conference mode the class swallows \thanks, \keywords, \PARstart, \pubid, \IEEEmembership and \IEEEaftertitletext (l.4531-4566), and \IEEEoverridecommandlockouts restores them (l.4572), so a document's \thanks prints as root.tex's author notes do; \overrideIEEEmargins widens the binding-side margin as PaperPlaza's printer asks (l.1191). The third line: the class defines \proof and \endproof with \def (l.3947-3948), and amsthm, which General loads, declares proof with \newenvironment (amsthm.sty l.431), which stops at 'Command \proof already defined'; the hook clears both just before amsthm loads, so amsthm's proof is used (not yet compiled). The class sets \rmdefault ptm, \sfdefault phv and \ttdefault pcr (l.790-792), which General's fontspec lines replace with Latin Modern under XeTeX; its paper-size code sets \pdfpagewidth and \pdfpageheight, which XeTeX has (l.831-838). The kit's IEEEtran.bst (IEEEtranBST.zip) is the mirror's ieeetran package. Licence: Perl Artistic License (the IEEEtran V1.6b header).
